records.title: XShift: FPGA-efficient Binarized LLM with Joint Quantization and Sparsification
records.reason: The worklist has the stable IEEE DOI and exact title. DOI resolver/Xplore did not yield the primary abstract (web open returned non-retryable internal error); the official DAC program confirms title/authors only. No abstract-based relevance claim is made.

records.title: MixFP4: Enhancing NVFP4 with Adaptive FP4/INT4 Block Representations
records.reason: The arXiv abstract describes adaptive FP4/INT4 block representations for NVFP4 LLM weights, quantization robustness, and inference throughput/memory efficiency; this directly targets LLM quantization and inference.

records.title: Speculative Streaming: Efficient and Scalable Speculative Decoding with Multi-Stream Attention
records.reason: The ACL Anthology abstract presents speculative streaming with multi-stream attention to overlap draft generation/target verification, reporting 2–3.5x decoding speedups; direct LLM decoding efficiency.

records.title: Scout Before You Attend: Sketch-and-Walk Sparse Attention for Efficient LLM Inference
records.reason: The abstract introduces Sketch-and-Walk sparse attention for LLM inference, reducing attention work at 20% density and reporting up to 6x inference speedup.

records.title: Growing a Twig to Accelerate Large Vision-Language Models
records.reason: The CVF abstract proposes Twig Token Pruning for MLLM inference, pruning redundant visual tokens while retaining quality and reporting large speedups; direct multimodal inference efficiency.

records.title: KVBuffer: IO-aware Serving for Linear Attention
records.reason: The abstract proposes KVBuffer, an IO-aware cache strategy for serving linear attention, reducing serving latency and raising request throughput in speculative verification.

records.title: Review of the Evolution of Large Language Model Algorithms
records.reason: The official ZTE publisher abstract surveys LLM methods and specifically includes distributed inference, compute and memory-access optimization, and quantization; the candidate resolves to DOI 10.12142/ZTETJ.202402003.

records.title: ViBE: Co-Optimizing Workload Skew and Hardware Variability for MoE Serving
records.reason: ViBE co-optimizes MoE workload skew and hardware variability for serving, with SLO/TTFT gains; directly addresses MoE inference scheduling.

records.title: CLAQ: Pushing the Limits of Low-Bit Post-Training Quantization for LLMs
records.reason: The abstract introduces low-bit post-training quantization for LLM weights and reports compression/accuracy results; direct weight-compression method.

records.title: ReALLM: A general framework for LLM compression and fine-tuning
records.reason: ReALLM provides an LLM compression and fine-tuning framework targeting sub-4-bit weight quantization; direct model-size/inference deployment efficiency.

records.title: Optimizing Native Sparse Attention with Latent Attention and Local Global Alternating Strategies
records.reason: The abstract combines Native Sparse Attention with latent attention/local-global alternation to reduce attention and KV-cache cost for LLM inference.

records.title: Cost-Aware Contrastive Routing for LLMs
records.reason: Cost-aware contrastive routing selects a less expensive LLM while preserving task quality; the method directly targets inference cost and latency.

records.title: Stem: Rethinking Causal Information Flow in Sparse Attention
records.reason: Stem is a causal sparse-attention method for Transformers/LLMs and reduces attention computation and prefill latency.

records.title: AdaHOP: Fast and Accurate Low-Precision Training via Outlier-Pattern-Aware Rotation
records.reason: The primary abstract limits AdaHOP to low-precision LLM training (training speed and training-memory compression); it gives no inference/deployment connection. Training-only optimization is outside this Discovery scope.

records.title: In-Batch Ensemble Drafting: Toward Fast and Robust Speculative Decoding for Multimodal Language Models
records.reason: The official OpenReview PDF's indexed primary text exposes the abstract: In-Batch Ensemble Drafting batches multiple multimodal/text/caption draft distributions during speculative decoding, improving target verification with minimal overhead. Direct OpenReview browsing was blocked by its browser challenge, but the official indexed PDF supplied the abstract.

records.title: QET: Enhancing Quantized LLM Parameters and KV cache Compression through Element Substitution and Residual Clustering
records.reason: QET quantizes LLM weights and KV-cache matrices and reduces quantization error using element substitution/residual clustering; direct memory/compression relevance.

records.title: Strong Drafts Need Compact Memories: Long-Context Speculative Decoding with Compressed KV Cache
records.reason: The abstract compresses draft-side KV state for long-context speculative decoding, lowering memory use and increasing decoding speed.

records.title: HIGGS: Pushing the Limits of Large Language Model Quantization via the Linearity Theorem
records.reason: The ACL abstract presents HIGGS data-free LLM quantization using a linearity result and dynamic-programming compression under an error constraint; direct model compression.

records.title: GRINQH: Graded Input-based Quantization Hierarchy for Efficient LLM Generation
records.reason: GRINQH uses graded-input weight-only post-training quantization to accelerate LLM generation/decode.

records.title: IMBPS - Iterative MLP Blocks with Parameter Splits for Improving LLM Inference
records.reason: The pinned worklist and official HiPC program establish the stable DOI/title, but DOI/IEEE primary abstract retrieval failed; official program material exposes title/authors only. The title suggests LLM inference optimization, but without the primary abstract it is not accepted.
